title: Bad holders.
text: Bad holders.. These toothpicks are nice. They come in 3 nice large holders But the issue I have is 1 the top of the holders was broken, and the bottom of the other 2 Are very warped and the lid won't go on. After I squeeze the bottom of the 2 warp ones to get the lid to go down they pop right back up.
